items.title: New CG software you may have missed: 18 October 2026
items.excerpt: Weekly roundup: NVIDIA's RTX video upscaling, frame generation and SDR-to-HDR now run locally as ComfyUI custom nodes (plus Krea 3, FLUX 3 Klein, Nano Banana 2.1 support); Maxon's Autograph adds an MCP server to drive it from Claude or ChatGPT, and Red Giant 2027 adds AI depth/normal-map relighting in After Effects.

items.title: Fal Debuts FLUX 3 Max Video Model Post-Trained With Black Forest Labs
items.excerpt: fal announced FLUX 3 Max on October 19, a video generation model post-trained by fal Research with Black Forest Labs on the FLUX 3 foundation model, available the same day via fal's API for image-to-video work.

items.title: VAST Open-Sources EdenLive, a Real-Time Model That Renders Simple Game Footage as Detailed Video
items.excerpt: Tripo maker VAST open-sourced EdenLive, a generative renderer that keeps upstream game state and paints detailed frames on top; the 5B model tops 24 FPS at 720p on a single RTX 5090, with weights and code released.

items.title: OpenAI testing new "Aurora" GPT-Image model on Arena
items.excerpt: Three 'aurora' alpha image models briefly surfaced in OpenAI's API over the weekend and have turned up in Arena image tests, suggesting a GPT-Image-3 successor is in testing.

items.title: How to shape your slides and videos with Gemini Notebook
items.excerpt: Gemini Notebook is giving users more creative control over generated Slide Decks and Video Overviews, letting them co-create and steer the visual output rather than accept a one-shot result.

items.title: NVIDIA Advances Agentic Security for Media, From European Public Service Broadcasting to Global Content Production
items.excerpt: NVIDIA expanded sovereign AI standards with the EBU for broadcasters, while NVIDIA-accelerated Adobe Frame.io workflows help studios search and find content faster across massive media libraries.

items.title: The Kiwibank sheep went viral for all the wrong reasons, and there's something every brand can learn from it
items.excerpt: Kiwibank's AI-generated sheep mascot backfired online; Creative Bloq argues brands deploying AI mascots must be prepared to give up some control over how they're remixed.

items.title: This weird legal case could change how we think of copyright forever
items.excerpt: A legal fight over the 'Italian Brain Rot' meme characters may look like kids' nonsense, but Creative Bloq argues it could have profound effects on how creative work is owned.

items.title: Olivia Rodrigo accused of using AI in expectations music video
items.excerpt: Viewers spotted tell-tale glitches, such as Chappell Roan appearing to be missing an arm, in Olivia Rodrigo's expectations video, fuelling allegations that generative AI was used in the production.

items.title: Human attention is the new old bottleneck. We have to design for it even more.
items.excerpt: Drawing on Anthropic's October 16 study showing its agents log six hours for every human hour, the essay argues designers' job is now building judgement systems for what deserves human attention.

items.title: Beyond the Canvas
items.excerpt: A recap of Config India 2026 in Bengaluru: designers are gaining unprecedented AI capabilities to turn ideas into working products, and 'design is the differentiator' was the event's core message.

items.title: What if AI sets us free?
items.excerpt: Starting from an ALS patient whose speech was restored by an AI brain implant, the author argues designers can keep humans in charge of whether AI liberates or diminishes us.

items.title: Introducing WunderUI - the agentic design system
items.excerpt: Design systems were built for humans who read docs, but much UI is now written by AI coding agents; WunderUI is pitched as a design system structured for agents to consume directly.

items.title: I Took a Claude-Built SaaS UI into Figma and Back to React
items.excerpt: A hands-on round trip: a Claude-generated expense-inbox UI (table, statuses, buttons) is taken into Figma for design work and then back to React.

items.title: How we built Renova's AI room redesigns
items.excerpt: Renova takes one photo of a room, house exterior, garden or pool and turns it into AI redesigns of the same space; the team walks through how they built it.

items.title: Appeals court upholds Thomson Reuters win in AI training lawsuit
items.excerpt: An appeals court upheld the 2025 ruling that Ross Intelligence's training of its AI on scraped Thomson Reuters content was not fair use, a precedent watched closely by creators whose work trains generative models.

items.title: Today's Vergecast: Why your favorite creator is building an app
items.excerpt: Creator Stephen Robles explains why he started building his own apps for his community and how AI is changing the way he designs and builds them.

items.title: AI-Edited Photos Can Lead People to Form False Memories
items.excerpt: New research finds AI-edited photographs and videos create false memories and make people more confident in the wrong version of events, a warning for image-makers using generative edits.

items.title: A Freshman Year Foundation for AI Filmmaking
items.excerpt: An educator argues that in the generative-AI era, traditional creative and filmmaking principles matter more than ever, outlining a first-year curriculum foundation for AI filmmaking.
